boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Misericordia University
boards.description: Ten currently documented evening food destinations in Dallas and the nearby Wyoming Valley, with stated late availability.

cards.title: Wendy's on Memorial Highway
cards.subtitle: 2685 Memorial Highway, Dallas, PA
cards.notes: Use the official location page to confirm the midnight close before heading out; it lists restaurant and drive-thru service every day.
cards.short_summary: A Dallas location with a documented midnight closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists this Dallas restaurant and its drive-thru as open 6:30 AM–12:00 AM daily.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 6:30 AM–12:00 AM daily; holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Prime at City Market
cards.subtitle: 2161 Memorial Highway, Dallas, PA
cards.notes: Plan this as an early-late dinner: the restaurant’s own hours page lists 10 PM closes Tuesday through Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Dallas dinner option with several 10 PM closing nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Prime at City Market lists closing at 10 PM Tuesday–Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours: Tuesday–Thursday 4–10 PM, Friday 11 AM–10 PM, Saturday 9 AM–10 PM; other days close earlier.

cards.title: Shams Hot Chicken
cards.subtitle: 418 Market Street, Kingston, PA
cards.notes: Check the day before traveling: Shams lists midnight closes Sunday through Friday and an 11 PM close on Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Kingston halal-food restaurant with midnight hours most nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Shams Hot Chicken states that its Kingston location is open until midnight Sunday through Friday and until 11 PM Saturday.
cards.source_title: Shams Hot Chicken — Kingston location and hours
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Kingston hours as 11 AM–12 AM Sunday–Friday and 12 PM–11 PM Saturday; holidays may vary.

cards.title: Kingza Asian Cuisine
cards.subtitle: 481 Market Street, Kingston, PA
cards.notes: Use Friday or Saturday for the later window; the restaurant’s ordering site lists a 10 PM close on both nights.
cards.short_summary: A Kingston Asian-cuisine stop with later weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Kingza Asian Cuisine lists Friday and Saturday business hours of 10:30 AM–10 PM.
cards.source_title: Kingza Asian Cuisine — location and business hours
cards.access_notes: Official site lists 10:30 AM–10 PM Friday and Saturday; Monday–Thursday and Sunday close at 9:30 PM.

cards.title: Taco Bell on South Wyoming Avenue
cards.subtitle: 110 South Wyoming Avenue, Kingston, PA
cards.notes: For a late drive-thru option, verify the official listing on the day; it identifies this Kingston location as open until 2 AM.
cards.short_summary: A Kingston Taco Bell designated by its official locator as open late.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official Kingston locator lists the 110 South Wyoming Avenue restaurant as open until 2 AM and offering drive-thru service.
cards.access_notes: Official locator identifies 110 South Wyoming Avenue as open until 2:00 AM and offering drive-thru; confirm same-day hours.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Kidder Street
cards.subtitle: 426 Kidder Street, Wilkes-Barre, PA
cards.notes: This is a farther Wyoming Valley option; its official page lists drive-thru service through 2 AM every day and dine-in through 11 PM.
cards.short_summary: A Wilkes-Barre Taco Bell with a documented 2 AM drive-thru.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the 426 Kidder Street drive-thru as open 9 AM–2 AM daily, with dine-in hours ending at 11 PM.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru 9 AM–2 AM daily; dine-in is listed until 11 PM, so use drive-thru after that.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Carey Avenue
cards.subtitle: 652 Carey Avenue, Hanover Township, Wilkes-Barre, PA
cards.notes: Confirm the weekday before leaving: the official page lists 1 AM drive-thru closes Sunday through Wednesday and 2 AM on Thursday through Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Wilkes-Barre-area Taco Bell whose drive-thru runs past midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the 652 Carey Avenue drive-thru until 1 AM Sunday–Wednesday and until 2 AM Thursday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 652 Carey Avenue, Hanover Township
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru until 1 AM Sunday–Wednesday and 2 AM Thursday–Saturday; dine-in closes earlier.

cards.title: KFC on Wyoming Avenue
cards.subtitle: 523 Wyoming Avenue, Kingston, PA
cards.notes: Check the restaurant page before going; it lists this Kingston location open daily through 11 PM with drive-thru and carryout available.
cards.short_summary: A Kingston fried-chicken restaurant with an 11 PM daily close.
cards.evidence_claim: KFC lists its 523 Wyoming Avenue restaurant in Kingston as open 10:30 AM–11 PM every day.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists daily hours of 10:30 AM–11 PM and identifies drive-thru, carryout, and delivery services.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on Wyoming Avenue
cards.subtitle: 750 Wyoming Avenue, Unit 3, Kingston, PA
cards.notes: Make this a Friday or Saturday pickup plan: Pizza Hut’s official page lists 11 PM restaurant hours on those two nights.
cards.short_summary: A Kingston pizza pickup location with later weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut lists its Kingston restaurant at 750 Wyoming Avenue as open until 11 PM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists restaurant hours until 11 PM Friday and Saturday, with 10 PM closes on other days; delivery hours may vary.

cards.title: Loko Chef
cards.subtitle: 17 East Union Street, Kingston, PA
cards.notes: Use this for a weekday carryout plan: the restaurant’s site lists Monday through Friday service until 11 PM and weekend closure.
cards.short_summary: A Kingston Mexican-Italian restaurant with late weekday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Loko Chef lists business hours of 11 AM–11 PM Monday through Friday at 17 East Union Street in Kingston.
cards.source_title: Loko Chef — location and business hours
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Monday–Friday hours of 11 AM–11 PM and states that Saturday and Sunday are closed.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-admission day-use outings at Pennsylvania state parks; pack water, coordinate transportation, and use the posted park guidance.

cards.title: Walk Frances Slocum Lake
cards.subtitle: Wyoming, PA • Pennsylvania state park
cards.notes: Meet at the lake day-use area for a low-key walk and wildlife spotting. Check the park map and current conditions before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A lakeside walk with room for conversation and birdwatching.
cards.evidence_claim: DCNR identifies Frances Slocum State Park as a Pennsylvania state park with a lake, day-use area, hiking trails, and wildlife viewing; Pennsylvania state parks charge no entrance fee.
cards.source_title: Frances Slocum State Park | Pennsylvania Department of Conservation and Natural Resources
cards.access_notes: Day-use outing; follow park rules and posted seasonal or weather notices. Pennsylvania state parks do not charge an entrance fee.

cards.title: Take a Creek-and-Wetlands Walk
cards.subtitle: Drums, PA • Pennsylvania state park
cards.notes: Use the park’s trail information to choose a daylight hike near Nescopeck Creek, then pause at the wetlands for a shared nature break.
cards.short_summary: Creekside trails and wetland scenery for an unhurried group outing.
cards.evidence_claim: DCNR says Nescopeck State Park has hiking trails following Nescopeck Creek and skirting wetlands; Pennsylvania state parks charge no entrance fee.
cards.source_title: Nescopeck State Park | Pennsylvania Department of Conservation and Natural Resources
cards.access_notes: Open daily from sunrise to sunset; day-use areas close at dusk. Pennsylvania state parks do not charge an entrance fee.

cards.entity_name: Glens Natural Area at Ricketts Glen State Park
cards.title: See the Glens’ Waterfalls
cards.subtitle: Ricketts Glen State Park • Pennsylvania state park
cards.notes: Plan a daylight walk with friends in the Glens Natural Area and stay on marked trails; review the park’s conditions before committing to a route.
cards.short_summary: A waterfall-focused walk through a protected natural area.
cards.evidence_claim: DCNR describes Ricketts Glen State Park’s Glens Natural Area as a natural landmark with stream erosion and spectacular waterfalls; Pennsylvania state parks charge no entrance fee.
cards.source_title: Natural Areas | Pennsylvania Department of Conservation and Natural Resources
cards.access_notes: Use designated trails and check current park guidance for trail conditions. Pennsylvania state parks do not charge an entrance fee.

cards.title: Look Out Over Lehigh Gorge
cards.subtitle: Pennsylvania state park
cards.notes: Choose a daylight stop along the Lehigh Gorge Trail, bring water, and use the official park information to pick a section suitable for your group.
cards.short_summary: A shared scenic stop along a dramatic river gorge.
cards.evidence_claim: DCNR describes Lehigh Gorge State Park’s rocky gorge and identifies the Lehigh Gorge Trail; Pennsylvania state parks charge no entrance fee.
cards.source_title: Geologic Features | Pennsylvania Department of Conservation and Natural Resources
cards.access_notes: Plan for daylight and consult official park maps and notices. Pennsylvania state parks do not charge an entrance fee.

cards.title: Pause at University Chapel
cards.subtitle: Mercy Hall • Misericordia University
cards.notes: Take a quiet daytime pause in the chapel, or attend a scheduled liturgy. The university says the chapel is open for private prayer during the day.
cards.short_summary: A calm on-campus space for reflection or a scheduled service.
cards.evidence_claim: Misericordia states that University Chapel, on Mercy Hall’s first floor, is open for private prayer during the day and that all are welcome at its liturgies.
cards.access_notes: Open for private prayer during the day; confirm scheduled liturgy details with Mission, Ministry and Service. No admission or purchase is stated.

cards.title: Browse the Pauly Friedman Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Insalaco Hall • Misericordia University
cards.notes: Visit the current exhibition with friends, then compare one work each that caught your attention. Off-campus visitors should contact the gallery in advance.
cards.short_summary: A campus gallery visit built around current exhibitions and conversation.
cards.evidence_claim: Misericordia states that admission to the Pauly Friedman Art Gallery is always free to all and offers free tours by appointment.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Pauly Friedman Art Gallery, Misericordia University
cards.access_notes: Admission is always free to all. The gallery posts hours and closure notices; off-campus visitors are encouraged to call or email ahead.

cards.entity_name: Pauly Friedman Art Gallery Free Programs
cards.title: Join a Free Gallery Program
cards.subtitle: Pauly Friedman Art Gallery • Insalaco Hall
cards.notes: Check the gallery’s events listing for a free art conversation or workshop, then make a plan with friends around a program that fits the posted schedule.
cards.short_summary: Gallery-led conversations and workshops when they appear on the calendar.
cards.evidence_claim: Misericordia’s gallery says its events listings include free in-person and virtual programs, including art conversations and workshops with curators and artists.
cards.source_title: About Pauly Friedman Art Gallery | Misericordia University
cards.access_notes: Programs vary by date and may require registration; confirm the individual event listing before attending. Listed free programs require no purchase.

cards.entity_name: Study Rooms at Mary Kintz Bevevino Library
cards.title: Claim a Library Study Room
cards.subtitle: Mary Kintz Bevevino Library • Misericordia University
cards.notes: Reserve a group study room for a shared work session, whiteboard brainstorm, or low-key catch-up. Bring your own materials and use the room respectfully.
cards.short_summary: A student-use room for collaborative studying and planning.
cards.evidence_claim: Misericordia lists study rooms for student use at Mary Kintz Bevevino Library, including rooms with whiteboard walls and touch screens.
cards.access_notes: For Misericordia students; room reservations are handled through the library’s online reservation system. No admission or purchase is required for the student-use space.

cards.title: Settle into the Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Misericordia University campus
cards.notes: Bring a friend for a focused reading block or a quiet planning session in the library’s Learning Commons, then ask library staff for help if needed.
cards.short_summary: A central campus setting for quiet work and research support.
cards.evidence_claim: Misericordia describes Mary Kintz Bevevino Library as a campus Learning Commons and says it has study rooms for student use.
cards.access_notes: For university users; library access and services follow posted policies. No admission or purchase is required to use this student learning space.

cards.title: Move Around at the Brassington Dome
cards.subtitle: Brassington Athletic Dome • Misericordia University
cards.notes: Check availability with Athletics before going, then use the indoor turf setting for a simple group recreation session that fits posted access rules.
cards.short_summary: An indoor turf option for student recreation when available.
cards.evidence_claim: Misericordia states that the Brassington Athletic Dome is available year-round for sports teams, non-athlete students, and the local community for training, recreation, and events.
cards.access_notes: Availability depends on university scheduling and access rules; confirm before visiting. No admission or purchase is stated for the listed student recreation access.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Misericordia gatherings and recurring campus practices, from the first welcome to graduation season.

cards.title: Welcome Week
cards.subtitle: Beginning-of-year campus tradition
cards.notes: Check the published schedule, pick a program that fits your arrival plans, and use it to meet new and returning members of the campus community.
cards.short_summary: A university-wide start-of-year gathering that began at Misericordia in 2018.
cards.evidence_claim: Misericordia states that Welcome Week began as a new campus tradition in August 2018 and runs from the first Monday of the academic year through Labor Day.
cards.access_notes: See the official schedule for the current year's events and participation details.

cards.title: Convocation
cards.subtitle: Academic-year opening ceremony
cards.notes: Follow the university calendar for the ceremony time and location, then attend or watch the official broadcast if an in-person visit is not possible.
cards.short_summary: The annual ceremony that officially opens the academic year and welcomes new students.
cards.evidence_claim: Misericordia's alumni events page calls Convocation a cherished annual tradition that officially kicks off the academic year and welcomes incoming freshmen.
cards.access_notes: The university lists Convocation on its events calendar; confirm the current date, location, and viewing options.

cards.title: Homecoming
cards.subtitle: Cougar community weekend
cards.notes: Use the official Homecoming page to identify student and alumni events, then follow any stated registration or entry instructions for the activity you choose.
cards.short_summary: A recurring weekend for current students, alumni, and the Misericordia community.
cards.evidence_claim: Misericordia announces Homecoming as a recurring campus weekend and directs visitors to additional events hosted by Alumni Relations.
cards.access_notes: Dates and individual event requirements change annually; consult the official Homecoming listing.

cards.title: Homecoming Talent Show
cards.subtitle: Lemmond Theater · Homecoming program
cards.notes: Attend the announced performance at Homecoming, or use the official student sign-up when audition or performer registration is offered.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled annual talent show within Misericordia's Homecoming programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Misericordia's Homecoming page identifies an Annual Talent Show and invites current students to sign up to perform.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists the current show's date, venue, and performer-registration deadline when available.

cards.entity_name: Annual David A. Evans Memorial Color Run
cards.title: David A. Evans Memorial Color Run
cards.subtitle: Annual 5K during Family Weekend
cards.notes: Watch Family Weekend information for the route and start details, then participate at a pace that works for you or support the event from the course.

cards.evidence_claim: Misericordia describes the David A. Evans Memorial Color Run as an annual 5K held in memory of David Evans Jr. and says it raises funds for a scholarship.
cards.access_notes: Check the current Family Weekend schedule for event timing, registration, and participant guidance.

cards.title: Family Weekend
cards.subtitle: Annual family-and-campus gathering
cards.notes: Invite family or supporters, review the official weekend schedule together, and register ahead for any activity marked as requiring advance participation.
cards.short_summary: A recurring Misericordia weekend built around programs for students and their families.
cards.evidence_claim: Misericordia publishes Family Weekend information and includes an announced 2026 save-the-date for the program.
cards.access_notes: Review the official schedule when released; some activities may have separate registration requirements.

cards.title: Fall Fest
cards.subtitle: Campus Life autumn program
cards.notes: Look for the Campus Life announcement, then join the listed seasonal activities and follow any event-specific participation instructions on arrival.
cards.short_summary: A campus fall program associated with themed activities and seasonal treats.
cards.evidence_claim: Misericordia's Campus Life page describes Fall Fest as a program welcoming the autumn season, including themed programs such as the Misericordia Hoe-Down.
cards.source_title: Spectacular Student Engagement Events! | Misericordia University
cards.access_notes: Campus Life announces dates and locations for currently scheduled programming.

cards.title: 5 Days of Give-a-ways
cards.subtitle: Holiday-season Campus Life program
cards.notes: Check Campus Life announcements during the holiday season, be present for the listed lunch-hour drawing, and follow staff instructions for claiming any prize.
cards.short_summary: A holiday-season series of lunch-hour prize drawings sponsored by Campus Life.
cards.evidence_claim: Misericordia states that Campus Life sponsors 5 Days of Give-a-ways during the holiday season and calls seat numbers during lunch-hour giveaways.
cards.source_title: Spectacular Student Engagement Events! | Misericordia University
cards.access_notes: Availability and drawing details are announced by Campus Life for each holiday-season program.

cards.title: Midnight Breakfast

cards.short_summary: A late-night breakfast and activity break offered before fall and spring finals.
cards.evidence_claim: Misericordia states that New Student & Family Programs and Campus Life sponsor Midnight Breakfast every semester before fall and spring finals.
cards.source_title: Spectacular Student Engagement Events! | Misericordia University
cards.access_notes: The official page identifies it as a late-night study break; verify the current semester's time and location.

cards.title: Chocolate Week
cards.subtitle: Spring-semester Campus Life program
cards.notes: Follow Campus Life notices during the spring term, choose a listed chocolate-themed activity, and check the announcement for any sign-up or supply limits.
cards.short_summary: A spring-semester week of chocolate-themed campus programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Misericordia's Campus Life page says Chocolate Week is offered in the spring semester and is dedicated to chocolate-related programming.
cards.source_title: Spectacular Student Engagement Events! | Misericordia University
cards.access_notes: Confirm the current spring schedule and participation details through Campus Life.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Misericordia University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A calm, campus-centered first-weekend sequence built around named Misericordia destinations and recurring opportunities.

cards.title: Start at the Iconic Arch Entrance
cards.subtitle: Friday arrival · upper campus
cards.notes: Use the named arch as a clear arrival landmark, then orient yourself with the university’s upper-campus map before heading farther in.
cards.short_summary: Begin with a recognizable campus landmark and map check.
cards.evidence_claim: Misericordia’s Upper Campus Map lists The Iconic Arch Entrance as a map point.
cards.access_notes: Use the online campus map to identify the destination; access conditions are not stated on the map page.

cards.title: Settle in at Bevevino Library
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · campus learning commons
cards.notes: Find a study room, ask for research help, or make a low-key plan for the weekend in the library’s central Learning Commons.
cards.short_summary: A practical first stop for study space, support, and planning.
cards.evidence_claim: The library describes itself as a campus Learning Commons with study rooms, research assistance, and Sunday–Thursday hours until midnight.
cards.access_notes: The university says it is open until midnight Sunday through Thursday; confirm current hours before visiting.

cards.title: Look in on the Pauly Friedman Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Insalaco Hall
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition listing and take time for the gallery’s special exhibits or lectures when one is scheduled during your visit.
cards.short_summary: A named campus gallery with changing exhibits and lectures.
cards.evidence_claim: Misericordia states that the Pauly Friedman Art Gallery is in Insalaco Hall and hosts special exhibits and lectures throughout the year.
cards.source_title: Arts, Film, and Music - Misericordia University
cards.access_notes: Exhibitions and access can vary; consult the university’s current art information before going.

cards.title: Get oriented at Banks Student Life Center
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · campus services
cards.notes: Locate this student-services hub early so you know where to return for campus-life questions, mail, or other practical needs.
cards.short_summary: Identify a central student-services destination on day one.
cards.evidence_claim: Misericordia identifies Banks Student Life Center as the location of the Dean of Students office, and its post office is located in the Banks Student Center.
cards.access_notes: The post office serves students, faculty, and staff and is also open to the public; its listed weekday window hours do not establish weekend availability.

cards.title: Take an outdoor pause at Wells Fargo Amphitheater
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · upper campus
cards.notes: Walk to the named amphitheater for a brief outdoor reset, and check university event listings in case a campus program is scheduled.
cards.short_summary: Build in a simple outdoor stop at a named campus venue.
cards.evidence_claim: Misericordia’s Upper Campus Map lists Wells Fargo Amphitheater as a map point.
cards.access_notes: The map confirms the location but does not state event schedules or public-access conditions.

cards.title: Tour the Anderson Sports and Health Center
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · north corner of campus
cards.notes: Make this a daylight destination: see the cougar statue and ask campus staff about current student recreation access before planning activity there.
cards.short_summary: See a major recreation facility and confirm how students may use it.
cards.evidence_claim: The university describes Anderson as a 78,000-square-foot multipurpose facility with recreational amenities and says facilities are open for student recreational use from early morning to late evening.
cards.source_title: Men's Soccer ID Clinic - Misericordia University
cards.access_notes: The cited page describes student recreational use but does not give a current posted schedule; verify access at the facility.

cards.title: Find the Tennis Courts
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · beside Anderson
cards.notes: Add the named courts to your campus walk and confirm availability with athletics or recreation staff before bringing equipment or starting a game.
cards.short_summary: Locate an outdoor recreation landmark near Anderson.
cards.evidence_claim: Misericordia’s Upper Campus Map lists Tennis Courts, and the university describes an outdoor tennis complex next to the Anderson Sports and Health Center.
cards.source_title: Men's Soccer ID Clinic - Misericordia University
cards.access_notes: The source identifies the courts but does not state public hours, reservation rules, or equipment availability.

cards.title: Walk through Shakespeare Garden
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · upper campus
cards.notes: Use this named garden as a quiet waypoint between campus stops; keep to posted paths and pair it with a look at the nearby map landmarks.
cards.short_summary: A brief, named outdoor waypoint for a slower campus walk.
cards.evidence_claim: Misericordia’s Upper Campus Map lists Shakespeare Garden as a map point.
cards.access_notes: The map confirms the destination but does not provide garden hours or use policies.

cards.title: Visit the University Chapel
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · first floor of Mercy Hall
cards.notes: If a spiritual or reflective stop fits your weekend, locate the chapel in Mercy Hall and consult Mission, Ministry and Service for current programming.
cards.short_summary: A reflective campus stop with documented student faith opportunities.
cards.evidence_claim: Misericordia states that University Chapel is on the first floor of Mercy Hall and that all students are welcome in its spiritual, religious, and service programs.
cards.access_notes: The page lists liturgy and program information; verify the current schedule or event eligibility before attending.

cards.entity_name: Center for Nursing History of Northeastern Pennsylvania
cards.title: Browse the nursing-history displays
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · Mary Kintz Bevevino Library
cards.notes: Look for the Center for Nursing History on the library’s second floor and use its collection displays as a focused final-campus exploration.
cards.short_summary: End with a collection that connects campus scholarship to regional history.
cards.evidence_claim: Misericordia says the Center for Nursing History is a multipurpose space on the library’s second floor with cases of original and facsimile collection material.
cards.access_notes: Located on the second floor of Mary Kintz Bevevino Library; the page does not state separate visitor hours.
